mapper.sql: CASE WHEN auditLog.correlation_id LIKE 'LEGACY-AUDIT-%' THEN 'LEGACY' WHEN auditLog.event_type = 'AUTH' THEN 'AUTH' WHEN auditLog.event_type = 'MENU_ACTION' THEN 'MENU' ELSE 'SECURITY' END

COALESCE( ( SELECT language.lang_desc FROM docs_menu menu JOIN docs_lang language ON language.lang_cd = menu.message_cd AND language.lang_type = #{sessionLang} WHERE menu.menu_cd = auditLog.menu_cd LIMIT 1 ), auditLog.menu_nm )

sql.if: AND ( CASE WHEN auditLog.correlation_id LIKE 'LEGACY-AUDIT-%' THEN 'LEGACY' WHEN auditLog.event_type = 'AUTH' THEN 'AUTH' WHEN auditLog.event_type = 'MENU_ACTION' THEN 'MENU' ELSE 'SECURITY' END ) = UPPER(#{sourceType})

AND ( COALESCE(auditLog.object_type, '') ILIKE '%' || #{targetKeyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(auditLog.object_id, '') ILIKE '%' || #{targetKeyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(auditLog.file_no, '') ILIKE '%' || #{targetKeyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(auditLog.request_no, '') ILIKE '%' || #{targetKeyword} || '%' )
AND auditLog.occurred_at >= (CAST(#{startDt} || ' 00:00:00' AS timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
AND auditLog.occurred_at < (CAST(#{endDt} || ' 00:00:00' AS timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') + INTERVAL '1 day'

SELECT auditLog.event_id AS "eventId", auditLog.event_id AS "logNo", TO_CHAR( auditLog.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS "occurredAt", TO_CHAR( auditLog.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS "logDt", TO_CHAR( auditLog.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS "date", AS "sourceType", auditLog.event_type AS "eventType", auditLog.actor_user_cd AS "userCd", auditLog.actor_user_id AS "userId", auditLog.actor_user_nm AS "userName", auditLog.actor_user_nm AS "userNm", auditLog.menu_cd AS "menuCd", AS "menuNm", auditLog.menu_url AS "menuUrl", auditLog.action_type AS "actionType", COALESCE(NULLIF(auditLog.action_nm, ''), auditLog.action_type) AS "actionNm", auditLog.result_cd AS "resultCd", auditLog.object_type AS "objectType", auditLog.object_id AS "objectId", auditLog.file_no AS "fileNo", auditLog.request_no AS "requestNo", auditLog.grade_cd AS "gradeCd", COALESCE( NULLIF( CONCAT_WS( ' · ', NULLIF(auditLog.object_type, ''), NULLIF(auditLog.object_id, ''), CASE WHEN NULLIF(auditLog.file_no, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'FILE ' || auditLog.file_no END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(auditLog.request_no, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'REQ ' || auditLog.request_no END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(auditLog.grade_cd, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'GRADE ' || auditLog.grade_cd END ), '' ), '-' ) AS "targetSummary", auditLog.reason_cd AS "reasonCd", auditLog.result_message AS "resultMessage", auditLog.client_ip AS "accessIp", auditLog.request_uri AS "requestUri", auditLog.http_method AS "httpMethod", auditLog.http_status AS "httpStatus", auditLog.duration_ms AS "durationMs", auditLog.correlation_id AS "correlationId", auditLog.detail_json::text AS "detailJson" FROM docs_access_audit_log auditLog WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY auditLog.event_id
ORDER BY auditLog.occurred_at

ORDER BY auditLog.event_type
ORDER BY auditLog.actor_user_cd
ORDER BY auditLog.actor_user_id
ORDER BY auditLog.actor_user_nm

ORDER BY auditLog.result_cd

LIMIT CAST(#{size} AS INTEGER) OFFSET ((CAST(#{page} AS INTEGER) - 1) * CAST(#{size} AS INTEGER))

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (auditLog.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date )::integer AS "totalToday", COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (auditLog.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AND auditLog.result_cd IN ('SUCCESS', 'ALLOW') )::integer AS "successToday", COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (auditLog.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AND auditLog.result_cd = 'DENY' )::integer AS "deniedToday", COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (auditLog.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AND auditLog.result_cd IN ('FAIL', 'FAILED', 'FAILURE', 'ERROR') )::integer AS "failedToday", COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(auditLog.actor_user_cd, auditLog.actor_user_id)) FILTER ( WHERE (auditLog.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AND COALESCE(auditLog.actor_user_cd, auditLog.actor_user_id) IS NOT NULL )::integer AS "activeUsersToday" FROM docs_access_audit_log auditLog
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_access_audit_log ( event_type, action_type, action_nm, result_cd, reason_cd, result_message, actor_user_cd, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm, menu_cd, menu_nm, menu_url, object_type, object_id, file_no, request_no, grade_cd, client_ip, session_id, correlation_id, request_uri, http_method, http_status, duration_ms, detail_json ) VALUES ( COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(#{eventType}), ''), 'AUTH'), CASE #{actionType} WHEN 'logIn' THEN 'LOGIN' WHEN 'logOut' THEN 'LOGOUT' WHEN 'loginFail' THEN 'LOGIN' WHEN 'changePassword' THEN 'PASSWORD_CHANGE' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(#{actionType}), ''), 'UNKNOWN') END, COALESCE( NULLIF(#{actionNm}, ''), CASE #{actionType} WHEN 'logIn' THEN '로그인' WHEN 'logOut' THEN '로그아웃' WHEN 'loginFail' THEN '로그인' WHEN 'changePassword' THEN '비밀번호 변경' ELSE #{actionType} END ), COALESCE( NULLIF(UPPER(#{resultCd}), ''), CASE WHEN #{actionType} = 'loginFail' THEN 'FAILURE' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END ), COALESCE( NULLIF(#{reasonCd}, ''), CASE WHEN #{actionType} = 'loginFail' THEN 'AUTHENTICATION_FAILED' END ), #{resultMessage}, #{userCd}, #{userId}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{userName}, ''), NULLIF(#{userNm}, '')), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{menuCd}, ''), 'AUTH'), COALESCE( NULLIF(#{menuNm}, ''), '인증 / 계정' ), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{menuUrl}, ''), '/login/**'), COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(#{objectType}), ''), 'USER_ACCOUNT'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{objectId}, ''), NULLIF(#{userId}, '')), #{fileNo}, #{requestNo}, #{gradeCd}, #{accessIp}, #{sessionId}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{correlationId}, ''), 'AUDIT-' || gen_random_uuid()::text), #{requestUri}, NULLIF(UPPER(#{httpMethod}), ''), #{httpStatus}, #{durationMs}, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(#{detailJson}, ''), '{}') AS jsonb) )
